notes: Summary: Onyx is migrating their internal inference platform to a managed dedicated offering. Primary drivers: predictable per-token economics, guaranteed throughput for low-latency chat, and corporate security controls.
Decision maker: CTO - Marco Li (primary), Platform lead - Priya Singh (technical lead), Procurement lead - Ben Carter.
They require a reserved GPU plan with capacity planning for seasonal peaks (financial reporting cycles). Initial ask: 8x A100 reserved in NA, option to expand to EU in Q4.

Latency/throughput targets discussed: aim for 95th pctl response <120ms for single-turn chat at 4k context; burst throughput target 100k tokens/min sustained for 10 minutes; sustained background batch embeddings 2M tokens/hour.

SLA negotiation items: customer insists on 99.99% uptime for Dedicated endpoint; Redwood default 99.95%. Onyx requests a dollar credit schedule tied to quarterly uptime and pro-rata service credits for degraded latency tiers.
Maintenance windows: Onyx will not accept maintenance between 07:00-19:00 PT for NA operations; requests 02:00-05:00 PT monthly windows and a 72-hour advance notice for planned upgrades.
Support response times: P1 - initial response 15 minutes, P2 - 1 hour, P3 - 4 hours. They want 24/7 phone escalation for P1 and an SLA for RCA within 5 business days for Sev1 incidents.
Data residency: logs retained in customer VPC; audit logs exported to Onyx SIEM. KMS integration required for model keys. Retention policy TBD (legal review).
Quote from Marco: 'We need deterministic inference for our trading desk — even small blips cost us. Credits are necessary but we need availability guarantees.'
Redwood asks: provide perf test for 8x-A100 pool (throughput/latency matrix), propose credit schedule options (3-tier and 5-tier), confirm maintenance blackout windows and escalation contacts.
Current status: Redwood delivered perf baseline (internal report); legal received initial SLA markup and returned with redlines on uptime and credits; awaiting Onyx legal's counter.
Notes style: shorthand on calls, lots of follow-ups. Priority: close contract Q2 to hit FY provisioning timelines.
